title: Chat context leaks across threads for the same user

fault.symptom: A reply in one thread contains context submitted in another thread.

root_cause.summary: The faulty session-key function uses only user_id.
root_cause.mechanism: Requests from the same user but different channel or thread scopes resolve to one shared in-memory context.
root_cause.correct_behavior: Build the session key from user_id, channel_id, and thread_id.

expected_diagnosis: Identify cross-thread context contamination rather than a client rendering issue.
Correlate requests from one user across distinct thread_id values.
Determine that the faulty session key omits channel_id and thread_id.
Recommend a composite session key scoped by user, channel, and thread.

expected_evidence.observation: The response to thread-beta contains the marker previously sent only to thread-alpha.
Requests with different thread_id values are assigned the same session_key while session_collision is active.
In normal mode, the same request sequence keeps each thread context isolated.
